title: Published Arrival and Departure Hours, Resort Lodging
content:
Each Resort Lodging unit type publishes the earliest time keys are issued on the arrival date and the latest time the unit must be left on the departure date, both on a 24-hour clock, together with the fee in USD for taking keys before the published check-in time where the unit is ready and the fee in USD for staying in the unit beyond the published check-out time.

| Unit type | Check-in time | Check-out time | Early check-in fee (USD) | Late check-out fee (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 16:00 | 10:00 | 45.00 | 65.00 |
| Slopeside Studio | 16:00 | 10:00 | 65.00 | 85.00 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 16:00 | 10:00 | 85.00 | 125.00 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 16:00 | 10:00 | 95.00 | 145.00 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 15:00 | 11:00 | 0 | 0 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 15:00 | 11:00 | 0 | 0 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 16:00 | 10:00 | 250.00 | 450.00 |

### Reading the hours

Two unit types, the Mountain Lodge Suite and the Summit Penthouse Residence, publish the earlier check-in time of 15:00 and the later check-out time of 11:00, and publish a fee of 0 for both early check-in and late check-out. The remaining five publish 16:00 and 10:00. The heaviest figures on the schedule belong to the Private Mountain Chalet, at 250.00 USD for early check-in and 450.00 USD for late check-out.
